messages:
Olivia C: ok folks, quick one — I need to swap my primary slot tomorrow morning (07:00-11:00 UTC). flight delay + family thing. can someone take primary? there's a lingering embeds latency alert from last night (P2), so ideally someone comfy with the KV-cache runbook and embeddings pipelines. i can hand over at 06:45 UTC and walk through the steps. @Samir P @Kevin B? :wave:

oncall-bot: Reminder: please update rotation in the schedule app if you swap duties. See /rotation for quick link.

Samir P: can do the 07:00-11:00 UTC window — i'll take primary. can you drop what the outstanding symptoms are? i saw a few timeouts on embed requests last night but not sure if it fully regressed.

Olivia C: awesome, thx Samir! symptoms were 500s and 1200ms tail latency on /v1/embeddings for certain customer prefixes. root looked like a hot shard on the KV cache layer + a backlog in the batcher. we did a soft-prefetch rollback and it helped but not fully. logs attached in the incident channel. main ops for handover: runbook -> https://redwood.runbooks/embed-kv-latency (note: runbook has the hot-shard mitigation and safe cache flush steps)

Kevin B: i can shadow 07:00-09:00 then pick backups if needed. quick q: any known customers actively seeing errors now?

Olivia C: last night we escalated to a handful of customers (acct IDs redacted in incident thread). PD notes show error spikes ended ~03:00 UTC but some elevated p95 persists. customer impact is degraded latency, not systemic failures. can be sticky.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alerts reduced to warnings for service=embeddings (see PD-INC-4432). Pager on-call: Samir P.

Samir P: reading the runbook — two quick clarifications: (1) when you say "safe cache flush" do we prefer the lane-level flush or full-prefix flush? (2) if flushing, is the recommended restart window 2 minutes or 5?

Olivia C: good q. prefer lane-level first: `curl -X POST https://ops.api/cache/flush -d '{"lane":"embeds-hot"}'` — only if that fails do full-prefix. restart window 2 minutes for the worker so it can warm; monitor KV miss-rates. I'll paste the exact commands at handover.

Emily S: adding runbook note — there's also a telemetry dashboard (ops/embed-cache) with a helper panel that marks the hot shard by lane id. check the "hot-lane" metric before flush.

Samir P: got it. i'll update rotation in the app now. Olivia, can you set a quick checklist in this thread of must-do items for the handoff?

Olivia C: sure — short checklist:
1) confirm primary switch in rota app (i'll do it but please verify)
2) open the embeds runbook, review hot-lane panel
3) check tail-latency dashboard and active PD incidents
4) attempt lane-level cache flush if p95 > 800ms for > 3 mins:
```
# lane-level flush
curl -X POST "https://ops.api/cache/flush" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"lane":"embeds-hot"}'
```
5) monitor `kv_hit_rate` and `batcher_queue_length` for 10m
6) if no improvement, escalate to quantized-model-fallback (see runbook)

Samir P: noted. i'll also add Kevin as shadow and update the PD escalation contacts. switching rotation now. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Rotation updated: primary for 07:00-11:00 UTC set to Samir P (shadow: Kevin B). Please confirm handoff at 06:45 UTC.

Kevin B: confirmed shadow. i'll be monitoring the dashboard from 06:30. if we need a fast rollback to the quantized variant, who owns that rollout?

Olivia C: rollout owner is me by default but i'll make you owner for the window — permissions already granted. command for immediate fallback (dry-run first):
```
# promote quantized variant (dry-run)
redwoodctl rollout create --model embeddings-v2-quant --target service/embeddings --dry-run
# then remove --dry-run to actually roll
```
If we do a real rollout, we keep canary=5% for 10m then 50% for 10m, watch error rate.

pagerduty-bot: PD NOTE: Samir P acknowledged PD-INC-4432 at 1765440200. Escalation policy intact.

Samir P: thanks all — i'll take the slot. Olivia, i'll ping you at 06:40 for quick sync and walk-through.

Olivia C: perfect. leaving the thread with the runbook, dashboards, and the minimal checklist so it's all in one place. good luck and ty! :pray:

Kevin B: thanks. if anything funky shows up i can take over immediate mitigation while Samir triggers rollouts.

Emily S: FYI i'll GH-assign the runbook update task to include the `--dry-run` snippet and a note about the 2m restart window. small doc tweak.

Samir P: one last thing — i'll also post a brief status update to #incidents if we see any customer-facing regression during the window.

Olivia C: perfect — thread closed for prep. see you at 06:45 UTC handoff. :rocket:
